Tamakkan

From a learning gap to a clear next step

  • Knowledge graphs
  • AI
  • Bilingual UX
Problem
Students may know they struggled in a prior course but still be unsure which concept to revisit or how it affects later courses.
Audience
University students deciding what to review in the context of their degree plan.
Project status
A proof of concept for a Curriculum-Aware Academic Gap Advisor (CAAGA), developed during my internship at Naseej AI Lab.
My contribution
I defined requirements, designed the interface and architecture, and built a slice of the curriculum knowledge graph and the learner model. I implemented gap detection, impact prioritization, practice and verification, and created a bilingual mathematics question bank.
A design decision
I modeled prerequisites at the concept level so a recommendation could explain why a specific topic matters. The flow compares evidence such as transcripts and assessment answers against curriculum relationships, explains the downstream impact of each gap, then routes students to targeted practice and separate verification questions.
Documented outcome
I reviewed the proof of concept for a peer-testing release and presented it internally. I tested transcript input with synthetic data, checked that practice resources matched their questions, and wrote test suites for the normal flow and edge cases.
